data.name: Eberhard
data.long_meaning: Eberhard is a Germanic name, derived from two Old High German elements: eber, meaning 'wild boar', and hard, meaning 'brave or strong'. The name was popular among the Germanic tribes and was borne by several early medieval rulers and saints.

in_hebrew.name: אברהרד
in_hebrew.meaning: אבר: אב בן רבהרד: חזק וקשה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אברהרד הוא שם שמקורו בשפה הגרמנית, אך ניתן למצוא את שורשיו בשפה העברית. השם מורכב משני חלקים: 'אבר' שיכול להתפרש כ'אב בן' או 'רבה', ו'הרד' שפירושו 'חזק' או 'קשה'. לכן, ניתן לפרש את השם אברהרד כ'אב בן חזק' או 'בן רבה חזק'.

in_greek.name: Εβέρхарντ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Εβέρхарντ έχει γερμανικές ρίζες, αλλά μπορεί να αναλυθεί και στην ελληνική γλώσσα. Το πρώτο μέρος 'Εβέρ' σχετίζεται με τον όρο 'πατήρ' (πατρική) και το δεύτερο μέρος 'χαρτ' σημαίνει 'γενναίος' ή 'δυνατός'. Έτσι, το Εβέρхарντ μπορεί να ερμηνευτεί ως 'γενναίος πατέρας' ή 'δυνατός απόγονος'.

in_latin.name: Eberhard
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Eberhard originates from Germanic roots, specifically from the Old High German words 'ever' meaning 'robust' or 'strong' and 'hard' meaning 'brave' or 'courageous'. This compound name signifies a person who is strong and brave, reflecting a character of resilience and fortitude. Historically, the name Eberhard was popularized by several medieval nobles and saints, contributing to its enduring presence in Christian traditions.

This name reflects a combination of strength and valor, suggesting a person who embodies both physical and moral fortitude. Historically, Eberhard has been a name borne by several saints and nobles, underscoring its significance in Christian tradition and its association with leadership and bravery.

data.cultural_impact: Eberhard was a common name among Germanic tribes, especially in the Middle Aages. Several rulers, warriors, and saints bore this name, including Eberhard I, Duke of the Franks, and Eberhard III, Margrave of Meissen. The name was also popular in the Russian Orthodox tradition, with several saints named Eberhard.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Eberhard carries the spiritual meaning of bravery and strength in the face of adversity. It is a reminder of the courage and resilience of the early Germanic tribes and the saints who carried this name. It also symbolizes the fierce protection of God and the sustainability of one's faith amidst challenges. The name Eberhard encourages us to face our challenges with the same strength and courage as the wild boar, knowing that God is with us every step of the way.
